name: Auto Drill: Galaxy
summary:
Pilot your own auto-mining ship and chew through entire planets, block by block! Your ship fights on its own — orbiting, seeking, and blasting the nearest block automatically. Sit back and watch the loot pour in, or grab the joystick and steer into the action yourself.

Your mining ship never stops working. It automatically targets and destroys blocks while you focus on building the ultimate galactic drilling machine.
